summary: Fixed six findings with minimal changes to export sanitization and its real download path, credential container inspection across all three runtimes, gallery byte-derived provenance, and the production workflow config guard. All three focused regression commands turned green after implementation; the full Git Bash verification gate then passed 269 Python tests plus 26 subtests, 145 frontend tests, 188 Worker tests and three mocked browser QA suites. The existing npm check gate, canonical static synchronization checks and a local esbuild Worker bundle passed; no dependencies or tests were removed. Changes are committed locally on devin/issue-18 without pushing.
